# Journals

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List journals

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals`

Retrieve a paginated list of journals with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, currency, defaultAccount, suspenseAccount, profitAccount, lossAccount, bankAccount, creator, inboundPaymentMethodLines, outboundPaymentMethodLines | `company,currency` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by journal name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[code]` | string | No | Filter by journal code (partial match) |  |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by journal type |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | integer | No | Filter by company ID |  |
| `filter[show_on_dashboard]` | boolean | No | Filter by dashboard visibility |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals?include=company%2Ccurrency&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals?include=company%2Ccurrency&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals?include=company%2Ccurrency&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create journal

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals`

Create a new journal

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Journal name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `code` | string | Yes | Journal code (max 5 chars). Must not be greater than 5 characters. |
| `type` | string | Yes | Journal type. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | Currency ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `default_account_id` | integer | No | Default account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `suspense_account_id` | integer | No | Suspense account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `profit_account_id` | integer | No | Profit account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `loss_account_id` | integer | No | Loss account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `bank_account_id` | integer | No | Bank account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `color` | string | No | Journal color (hex). Must not be greater than 7 characters. |
| `show_on_dashboard` | boolean | No | Show on dashboard. |
| `refund_order` | boolean | No | Refund order flag. |
| `payment_order` | boolean | No | Payment order flag. |
| `inbound_payment_method_lines` | object[] | No | Inbound payment method lines (for BANK, CASH, CREDIT_CARD journals). Include id for update, omit for create. |
| `outbound_payment_method_lines` | object[] | No | Outbound payment method lines (for BANK, CASH, CREDIT_CARD journals). Include id for update, omit for create. |
| `inbound_payment_method_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `inbound_payment_method_lines[].payment_method_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `inbound_payment_method_lines[].name` | string | Yes | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `inbound_payment_method_lines[].payment_account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `outbound_payment_method_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `outbound_payment_method_lines[].payment_method_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `outbound_payment_method_lines[].name` | string | Yes | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `outbound_payment_method_lines[].payment_account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Bank Journal",
  "code": "BNK",
  "type": "bank",
  "company_id": 1,
  "currency_id": 1,
  "default_account_id": 1,
  "suspense_account_id": 2,
  "profit_account_id": 3,
  "loss_account_id": 4,
  "bank_account_id": 1,
  "color": "#3b82f6",
  "show_on_dashboard": true,
  "refund_order": false,
  "payment_order": false,
  "inbound_payment_method_lines": [
    {
      "payment_method_id": 1,
      "name": "Manual",
      "payment_account_id": 5
    }
  ],
  "outbound_payment_method_lines": [
    {
      "payment_method_id": 2,
      "name": "Electronic",
      "payment_account_id": 6
    }
  ]
}'
```

```json
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
```

## Delete journal

<Badge type="tip" text="DELETE" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals/{id}`

Delete a journal

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The journal ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X DELETE "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals/{id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals/{id}", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('DELETE', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals/{id}', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/journals/{id}"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.delete(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="200" />

```json
{
  "message": "Journal deleted successfully."
}
```

```json
  "message": "Unauthenticated."
}
```
